# Test fixtures

PowerPoint files the `--import-potx` tests import. They're third-party files, kept under their own licenses:

| File | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `python-pptx-default.pptx` | [python-pptx](https://github.com/scanny/python-pptx/blob/master/src/pptx/templates/default.pptx): PowerPoint's plain default layouts, 4:3 | MIT |
| `bug60715.pptx` | [Apache POI test data](https://github.com/apache/poi/blob/trunk/test-data/slideshow/bug60715.pptx): layouts and a master with logo and footer pictures | Apache-2.0 |
